testTitle: 角色管理 › 查看采集工程师角色信息及权限描述 [CASE-000383]

coverage.text: 已登录系统且具有角色管理查看权限
coverage.implementation: globalSetup authenticates admin; openRolesPage confirms authenticated access by loading the role-management column header.
openRolesPage navigates to /admin/roles through openModule and waits for the 角色编码 column header.

coverage.text: 在角色列表中查找角色编码为collection_engineer的记录
coverage.implementation: expectRole filters the loaded data rows by the required role code and requires exactly one matching row.

coverage.text: 查看该记录的角色名称、描述、状态字段
coverage.implementation: expectRole reads the matching row role-name cell and asserts the expected value.

coverage.text: 角色管理列表页正常显示
coverage.implementation: openRolesPage asserts the four headers and exactly five populated role rows.

coverage.text: 找到角色编码为collection_engineer的记录
coverage.implementation: expectRole asserts the required role-code cell in the unique matching row.

coverage.text: 角色名称为“采集工程师”，描述为“工作台、我的采集权限”，状态为“启用”
coverage.implementation: expectRole asserts the required role-name cell in the unique matching row.
